# Summary fixtures from cb56b04

`evidence.zip` is a synthetic pytest PR merge comparison recorded by the cb56b04 CLI. The shared test checks two receipt values. The baseline fails the first check and the candidate fails the second. Another selected test passes on both versions. The report contains no contributor or production data. Local paths were replaced with fixture paths and the evidence manifest was refreshed before packing.

The cb56b04 CLI generated all four companion documents from this ZIP. The private pair uses `--gate no-new-failures --include-test-ids`. The public pair uses `--gate no-new-failures --public-summary`. The historical gate passes. The current gate requires review. The fixtures exercise offline verification without needing the original repository or Python environment.

`approved.md` was also generated by cb56b04 using `approval-plan.json`, its expected fingerprint and a verified approval from the synthetic reviewer Fixture maintainer. Tests generate a fresh key and signature for this same claim. The archived Markdown has neither the signing key nor the signature timestamp.
